messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeout rate detected for inference-gateway (us-west-2). 5xx spike started ~4567890000, current error rate 18%. Auto-throttles triggered.

alex: seeing a lot of 502/504s in the gateway logs and KV client timeouts. Heads-up, this might be the prefix cache.

maria: confirmed. Dashboard shows a KV miss spike and a sharp increase in prefix-cache eviction_rate on shard-7. Latency for cache reads jumped from 10ms -> 600ms.

cheng: paging oncall (cheng) — I'm taking this. First step: is there active rollout / config change?

jordan: no recent deploys to runtime or cache config per deploy-bot. No canary rollouts in the last hour.

cheng: copying logs, starting live debug. Can someone drop the tail of the cache pod logs?

alex: paste logs: ```[2026-02-20T13:41:12Z] shard-7 WARN eviction: triggered bulk-eviction count=1243 ttl=0.2s
[2026-02-20T13:41:13Z] shard-7 ERROR checksum: mismatch key=prefix://user/xyz crc32=0x1a2b expected=0x6f3c
[2026-02-20T13:41:13Z] shard-7 ERROR read: io timeout after 500ms\n[2026-02-20T13:41:14Z] gateway-1 WARN upstream: 502 response from runtime-12
```

maria: hm checksum mismatch + eviction flurry — smells like corruption + thrashing. Could be a memory pressure bug or an aggressive prefetch burst.

cheng: quick mitigation proposal: 1) disable prefix prefetching for hot routes, 2) route traffic around shard-7 (drain) 3) increase cache read timeout to 2s temporarily, 4) enable fallback to db read for misses. Thoughts?

jordan: +1 for draining shard-7. We should avoid changing timeouts too wide or we risk cascading latency. Maybe set read timeout to 1s first.

sam: I'll open a routing patch: mark shard-7 unhealthy in service-discovery and let traffic re-balance. Pushing now.

oncall-bot: Pager duty: cheng acknowledged the page at 13:42 UTC.

alex: routing change is live—traffic to shard-7 dropped to <1%. Downstream error rate falling to 10%.

maria: disabling prefix prefetch on the runtime config for the high-traffic prefix set. Patch posted to config-store, applying.

cheng: applied fallback: on cache error -> read-through to persistent KV (sync) with a 300ms deadline. This should reduce 5xx.

alex: after changes, gateway 5xx is down to ~4% and timeouts reduced. Good sign. Still seeing checksum mismatch logs but at lower volume.

jordan: we should take shard-7 pod for a graceful restart to clear possible corruption. Schedule once traffic is drained.

sam: restarting shard-7 replica-2 now (graceful). Monitor.

alex: restart complete. replica-2 came up healthy, no immediate checksum errors on that instance.

maria: customer impact: ~2.2% of requests in us-west-2 experienced errors during the peak window (~13:40-13:46 UTC). No SLA breaches (best-effort), but several customers reported transient failures. Logging tags: customer-impact:partial, affected-products:[generation, embeddings].

cheng: next steps for now: 1) keep shard-7 drained until we run deeper disk/ram checks, 2) enable eviction-throttle on shards to avoid future bursts, 3) run a repair sweep on prefix checksums, 4) create incident ticket and postmortem template. Assigning to maria and alex for RCA.

jordan: filing incident ticket: INC-20260220-011 -> assigned to alex/maria. Include timeline and mitigation steps.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: cheng will be on until 14:30 UTC, then handoff to jordan. Please update the ticket with any outstanding mitigations.

sam: adding quick mitigation note for ops-runbook: config keys changed: `runtime.prefetch.enabled=false` for prefix-set hotlist, `cache.eviction.throttle=0.5` applied to shard-7 and neighbors, `service-discovery.set_unhealthy(shard-7)=true` during maintenance.

alex: metrics to capture for postmortem: cache checksum error rate, eviction rate, mem/heap usage on shards, read latency distribution, gateway 5xx/timeouts, customer-request traces.

maria: I triggered a background scan to recompute checksums for prefixes on shard-7 replicas. It reports 0.3% corrupt entries — we'll quarantine and rehydrate from persistent store.

cheng: we're in stable mitigation: 5xx ~1.1%, latency near baseline. Keep monitoring for 1 hour, then start controlled reintroduction of traffic to shard-7 after we validate checksums and eviction-throttle behavior.

jordan: taking handoff at 14:30 UTC. If anything spikes, ping me @jordan. I'll keep the ticket updated.

alex: added customer communications draft to ticket: short note acknowledging transient errors, root cause under investigation (cache eviction/corruption), mitigations applied, ETA for postmortem 72 hours.

maria: one more ops note: we'll schedule a rolling deploy for cache binary with a fix for the eviction-path in the next maintenance window if QA passes.

cheng: thanks everyone. Closing live mitigation loop. Postmortem owners: alex/maria. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
